### ✦ ݁˖ Hewo, I'm Skye

Artist and frontend developer building my own version of the digital world, one step at a time. Concept artist at **MEGAB ✦**. These days I live somewhere between Blender, Godot Engine, sometimes Unreal Engine and far too many open tabs.

<details>
<summary><b>﹒ check more about me ﹒</b></summary>

<br>

I learned to program a long time ago, when I was a teenager taking apart the code of my favourite indie games. I've always loved technology and video games as much as graphic design, and I'm lucky to be surrounded by people I can now
call genuinely talented artists.

I've been hand-coding websites with HTML/CSS/JS for years and I still love it. My biggest project so far is my own site, **SKYE JOURNEY**.

I'm currently working on both personal and professional projects. I'm a concept artist for MEGAB ✦. I occasionally experience burnout, so please bear with me. Right now, I am on a long break. Thanks for stopping by. ✦

</details>
